mkdir -p programs; cat > programs/task-11d54ab9.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # The separator divides two panels. The output is a square of color 4
    # whose side is the shorter colored vertical run in the upper panel.
    rows = len(grid)
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    panels = (grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:])
    color_cols = {c: [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[j] == c for p in panels for row in p)] for c in (2,4)}
    # In this task the 2 and 4 markers are vertical strokes; the 4 marker
    # in the first panel determines the square size.
    c4 = color_cols[4][0]
    upper_run = sum(1 for row in panels[0] if row[c4] == 4)
    side = upper_run
    return [[4 for _ in range(side)] for _ in range(side)]
PY
